mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies over the Military Ridge State Trail and a moderate air quality index of 69.

The Verona Senior Center has been officially accredited by the Wisconsin Association of Senior Centers for their dedication to senior health and wellness, and the Plan Commission is meeting this November to discuss various development projects including new plats and site plans.
There are plenty of activities around town starting with Hop Haus Trivia and Quizmasters Trivia at Lake Lou-ee happening today, followed by Dream Day Trivia tomorrow.
On October 15, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I, and the investigation is ongoing to ensure the safety of our local students.
Stop by Culver's today to enjoy the Devil's Food Cake flavor of the day while they are open until 10:00 PM.
